logic.empty: No rules yet. Add a rule to show, hide or skip to a field depending on an answer.

fields.title: Fields
fields.body: Every field type you can add, grouped as Basic, Choice and Advanced. Drag a field onto your form, or select it to add it at the end.

canvas.title: Your form
canvas.body: This is the form as respondents will see it. Select any field to edit its label, help text and settings.

settings.title: Field settings
settings.body: Settings for the selected field, in three tabs: Field, Logic and Style. Use Logic to show, hide or skip fields depending on an answer.

preview.title: Preview
preview.body: Select Preview to fill in the form as a respondent would, with your logic rules running.

publish.title: Publish
publish.body: When the form is ready, select Publish and choose who can respond. You can keep editing after it is live.

errors.publishNoFields: Add at least one field before you publish this form.
errors.domainNotFound: We could not find a CNAME record for this domain yet. DNS changes can take up to 48 hours.
